name: ambientCG
description: Large source of PBR materials, HDRIs and 3D models suitable for game-development environment and look-development workflows.

licence.notice: ambientCG states all assets are released under CC0 and are free to use without attribution, including commercially. Verify the exact asset page at adoption and preserve source provenance.

provenance.notes: Licence statement is published by ambientCG on its official site; exact selected assets still receive per-asset provenance records when adopted.

maintenance.evidence: Official catalogue is active and publishes downloadable PBR materials, HDRIs and models.
maintenance.notes: Treat source catalogue qualification separately from exact production asset validation.

compatibility.notes: Resolution, compression, material conversion, geometry and memory budgets remain target/project specific.

risk.legalNotes: CC0 is strong for copyright reuse; still avoid assuming trademark/personality/other rights for any unusual depicted subject without review.
risk.securityNotes: Static downloadable assets; validate archives/files and normal import toolchain.

assessment.notes: High-value default discovery source for environment materials/HDRIs/models; exact assets require game-ready technical validation.

evidence.notes: Official site states all assets are CC0, attribution-free and commercially usable.

publication.notes: Publish factual licence/source metadata and independent By JTT evaluation; link to upstream assets rather than mirroring them.
